method.spatial_test: polygon intersection; unique coverage uses union of eligible completed polygons clipped to each planned polygon
method.area_accounting: Pairwise overlap sums are diagnostic only. unique_union_covered_ha and unique_union_plan_coverage_pct are the deduplicated union measures. Only meaningful spatial candidates within the three-year window contribute.
method.time_window: A completed polygon is temporally plausible when its Avvdatum is between the planned Inkomdatum and three years after it. Missing/unparseable dates are not counted as time-window matches.
method.meaningful_overlap_threshold: intersection >= 0.02 ha and overlap share >= 15% of at least one polygon
method.completed_layer_warning: Satellite-based change-detection layer. Spatial overlaps are candidates for manual review, not proof that a planned case was executed.
method.missing_planned_id_warning: An ID missing from a later query is only not returned by the current query; it does not prove deletion, expiry, or felling.
method.follow_up_status_method: Follow-up status is a heuristic: strong match requires meaningful overlap, date within 3 years and score >=65; no-detection labels depend on age since notification, not proof that felling did not occur. Candidate score is a ranking aid, not a probability.
method.match_score_formula: 0-100 heuristic: meaningful overlap +25, completed polygon coverage up to +30, planned polygon coverage up to +20, plausible timing +15, same municipality +10.

incomparable_snapshot_pairs.reason: The query geometry/scope changed between snapshots; ID differences are not interpreted as source changes.
